name: speaker-helper
summary: Speaker Helper — speech synthesis that runs in your process: say a sentence, stream a reply, or narrate a document with the timed track that lets a page follow along. Kokoro by default (no server), voice cloning through OpenVoice and Chatterbox. The inverse of vocal-helper: text in, speech out. Library + CLI + REST API + MCP + skill, with a built-in evaluation gate.
